main_text.p: Schafnaburgensem, Sarifburium, Petrarcham, Petrum Premonstratensem, Capgrauum, Crätzium, Nauclerum, Baptistam Mantuanum: & inter neo-tericos Robertum Barnum, Bibliandrum, Gassarū, Funccium, Pantaleonem, Lycosthenem, Vergeriū, Sleidanum, Matthiam Flacium Illyricum, & alios autores multo fideliores ac veriores.
main_text.head: De Petro Apostolo.
main_text.p: Gal 1.PEtrus autem, cum ex Christi Domini iussu ac praecepto, circumcisionis Apostolus fuerit, aequum profecto non erat, ut relicto Iudaeorum grege, 25.annis (ut somniant Papistæ) apud Gentes incircumcisas Romæ sederet, aut illic gentilium regum more imperaret. In Iudæa ergo, ac finitimis regionibus, Christi mandato obstrictus permansit, praedicans in maritimis urbibus Evangelium regni Dei: quod & ipsa testantur miracula, quæ per illum Deus operabatur. Nam Lyddæ paralyticum Æneam sanitati restituit, Tabitham Ioppæ a mortuis excitauit. In Cæsarea centurione Cornelium baptizauit, atque alibi alia plura fecit. Quæ omnia declarant, illum nec sedisse, nec mortem obiisse Romæ. Unde Baptista Mantuanus in sexto Fastorum libro:

Urbibus Assyrijs Christi post funera, postq̄
In cælum reditus, bis septem dicitur annos

page.notes: The first line of the page continues the previous page's list and is therefore marked cont="true". The "A 2" signature and the catchword at the foot are read from a faint scan. The catchword is partly cut off, so "Imper[?]" is a best reading. The ligatures and the s in "sedisse" and "Papistæ" are read as long s. The underline under "(ut somniant Papistæ)" and "testantur miracula" is a printed rule or underlining, not italic text. The verse line ends with the abbreviation q̄ as printed.
